title: Migration Report
description: Open standard for migration-report.json — a tool-agnostic, per-URL record of a content migration. Produced by migration tools (e.g. Portage), ingested by auditors (e.g. LinkCanary) to verify migrated URLs resolve on the destination. See cli/docs/migration-report-schema.md (normative spec, v1.0).

version.description: Schema version. MUST be "1.0" for this standard.

generated_by.description: Tool identifier and version, e.g. portage@0.9.2.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of report generation.

destination_base_url.description: Origin (plus optional path prefix) of the destination site. MUST NOT end with '/'. Consumers resolve every destination_path against this.

destination_platform.description: Destination platform identifier (e.g. astro, payload, sanity, keystatic).

records.description: One record per migrated source URL. May be empty.

source_platform.description: Platform the content came from. Registered vocabulary: ghost, gatsby, squarespace, substack, jekyll, next, wordpress, webflow, contentful, storyblok, medium, notion, astro, custom.

source_url.description: Original absolute URL on the source site, normalized per spec §4.2. MUST be unique across records.

destination_path.description: Absolute server-relative path where content landed. null when nothing was written. MUST start with '/'. MAY include a query string; MUST NOT include a fragment.

status.description: Disposition of this URL after migration. Closed vocabulary: migrated = content carried to destination_path (expect 2xx); redirected = URL now points elsewhere (source 3xx -> 2xx); quarantined = held back pending decision (source should be 4xx/5xx); failed = migration errored, needs review; excluded = intentionally not migrated (source should be 4xx/5xx).

images_rehosted.description: true when every image referenced by the item is served from the destination. Items with no images MUST be true (vacuously).

links_rewritten.description: true when every internal link in the item points at the destination. Items with no internal links MUST be true (vacuously).

redirect_target.description: Optional. Final absolute URL the source resolves to after all hops. Applies to status=redirected.

reason.description: Optional. Human-readable cause for quarantined/failed/excluded records.

checksum.description: Optional. Content checksum recorded on extract (portage: sha256, 12 hex chars) for content-drift detection.

asset_counts.description: Optional. Counts behind the booleans. Contradictions (e.g. images_failed > 0 with images_rehosted: true) SHOULD be warned on by consumers.

record.description: Unknown fields are permitted and MUST be ignored by consumers (forward-compatibility).
